questions.q: Air can be prevented from getting into the system by:
options: Keeping all glands and stuffing boxes on the high-pressure side tight
Keeping the dehydrator clean at all times
Keeping all glands and stuffing boxes on the low-pressure side tight
Running the refrigerant through an aerator
questions.answer: Keeping all glands and stuffing boxes on the low-pressure side tight

questions.q: An excessively high head pressure could be caused by:
options: Insufficient cooling water to the condenser
Insufficient cooling water to the evaporator coils
Too much cooling water to the condenser
questions.answer: Insufficient cooling water to the condenser

questions.q: The solenoid valve is controlled by:
options: The amount of liquid in the system
The amount of gas in the system
The thermal switch operated by the icebox temperature
questions.answer: The thermal switch operated by the icebox temperature

questions.q: If the discharge side of the thermal expansion valve is warmer than the inlet side:
options: Expansion valve is not working normally
Solenoid valve is not working normally
questions.answer: Expansion valve is not working normally

questions.q: If the pressure is too high:
options: The relief valve should open before the high-pressure cutout
The relief valve should open and let excess refrigerant go to receiver
The high-pressure cutout switch should operate before the relief valve
Close in on the suction valve
questions.answer: The high-pressure cutout switch should operate before the relief valve

questions.q: What is the effect of superheating the refrigerant?
options: It increases the coefficient of performance
It decreases the coefficient of performance
It lowers the boiling point of the refrigerant
It increases the suction pressure of the refrigerant
questions.answer: It increases the coefficient of performance

A twin-cylinder ammonia compressor with volume displacement of $14{,}726\text{ cm}^3$ per cylinder operates at 300 rpm. Condenser and evaporator pressures are 1,200 kPa and 227 kPa, respectively. Specific volume of refrigerant at the entrance of the compressor is 528.26 L/kg. The compression process is polytropic with $n = 1.2$ and the clearance factor of the compressor is 2%. Determine the horsepower required.
